title: 엽연초생산협동조합법시행령 / queue:ARTICLE:7:0:00007:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 7 (Registration of Establishment and Commencement of Business)
(1) Where a cooperative completes registration of establishment under Article 13 (1) of the Act and commences its business, it shall without delay report to the Minister of Economy and Finance with a certified copy of the registration of establishment. <Amended on December 23, 1994; December 26, 2002; February 29, 2008; December 30, 2025>
(2) Where a person authorized to establish a cooperative fails to register its establishment within the registration period under Article 13 (1) of the Act, the Minister of Economy and Finance may revoke the authorization of establishment. <Amended on December 23, 1994; December 26, 2002; February 29, 2008; December 30, 2025>
